A.name: Ground-truth provenance
A.details:
OPE initializes from the legal first-frame box and passes only RGB/depth images to subsequent actor.track calls. Its analysis path checks saved prediction hashes before loading the frozen evaluator, which opens dataset groundtruth.txt separately from saved predictions and confidence. Ground truth is not made from tracker output.

VOT's dataset loader reads groundtruth*.txt or groundtruth.txt; multistart analysis compares the returned trajectories with those dataset regions. Region rasterization uses intersection/union with image bounds and ignore masks. The official legal start box is an initialization input.

Inherited AB training loads and hashes dataset GT, executes the model step and then applies GT to the training objective. The declared toy07 alignment truncation is explicit in the loader. The teacher collects model-state rollouts before loading GT to compute current IoU and short-horizon labels; CurrentC uses the current-IoU field as a regression target. A prediction's overlap with real GT is supervised quality, not fabricated model-generated ground truth.

The complete raw current GT/image/prediction corpus is not supplied; the PASS is for the available source and recorded execution, not an independently replayed universal no-leak certificate.

B.name: Score normalization
B.details:
OPE confidence values define a threshold grid. At each threshold, precision is mean GT overlap over selected predictions, recall divides overlap sum by visible-GT count, sequence curves are macro-averaged, and the reported point maximizes harmonic F. Multiplication by 100 converts units. There is no division of reported performance by the model's own maximum/minimum/mean. The max-F point is the declared PR metric, not external checkpoint selection.

VOT accuracy uses overlap/progress, robustness uses progress/run length with sequence weighting, and EAO averages the expected-overlap curve over the declared interval. The stack orders EAO, EAO curve, then AR, matching the current reader's index extraction. Feature normalization, depth transformations and inference-score transformations are model operations, not hidden final-score denominators.

C.name: Actual files, numbers and completion
C.details:
Actual exported metric keys and numbers agree with the collector/controller. The two original observer exports contain 74 embedded artifact texts (28 early, 46 terminal); their UTF-8 byte hashes exactly match the supplied extracted files. All ten stages have matching launches/receipts and zero exits, as do controller and supervisor. The collector finished at 2026-10-11T13:39:06.699428+00:00, supervisor at 13:39:06.723425+00:00. This supports CurrentC completion at the recorded times.

Current raw OPE trajectories, VOT trajectory files and original full official analysis JSON are not supplied locally. The current composite checkpoint/bundle/bank and current complete plans are paths/digests plus recorded assertions; their raw contents were not independently reconstructed. A digest list is not raw numerical reproduction.

The sealed tracker row 52 still says VOT_RUNNING 1763/1765; row 60 still says M123 NOT_LAUNCHED. Later actual terminal/launch records supersede these current-status strings. This is a documentation lag, not evidence that terminal metric files are missing. Synchronize current rows after sealing; preserve the frozen input and historical statements.

D.name: Metric call reachability
D.details:
The controller explicitly runs both PR analyses, native VOT evaluate, native VOT analysis, VOT sealing and final collection; matching stage receipts support execution. evaluate_depthtrack_results and collect_confirmed_failure_outcomes are called, and outputs appear in actual result files. The VOT launch calls python -m vot analysis with the current master workspace, JSON format, current_quality_C_full152_full127 analysis name and sttrack_m122_P1_current_quality_C_full152 tracker.

Older imported diagnostic functions such as summarize and paired_vs_empty, and formatting helpers, are not claimed as executed CurrentC test metrics. None substitutes for a missing one of the nine scores. Available local source dependencies were followed; missing VOT support modules and live library identity remain disclosed rather than labeled inspected.

E.name: Scope, training and protocol
E.details:
One fixed selected CurrentC composite final was evaluated on the complete recorded DepthTrack Test50, CDTB80 and VOT127/1765-anchor scopes. One fixed training seed/configuration is documented. This supports descriptive complete-scope single-run reporting, not multi-seed robustness, causal language benefit, novelty, SOTA or deployment safety.

CurrentC is inherited complete AB training plus cached current-quality C regression, not newly completed full ABC joint training. Teacher coverage is 152 sequences, but 1257 eligible cached events come from 142. The former C development32 partition now belongs to training, so its earlier development numbers are not a held-out validation score for this new final.

Human text is manually reviewed with multiframe/video aids. Online causal state after legal initialization does not make this blind automatic first-frame captioning. M123 is a separate startup receipt/process-tree observation only; there is no observed optimizer count, completed training or new score in this audit.

F.name: Evaluation classification
F.details:
DepthTrack Test, CDTB and VOT RGB-D are real_gt evaluations. Manual human-reviewed text is additional initialization input; it does not turn the objective tracking metric into human_eval.

CurrentC training MSE is real_gt-derived surrogate regression on cached teacher current IoU, not test accuracy or future-utility evidence. Hashes, source contracts, observation-key reconstruction, coverage and metadata ROB are deterministic consistency checks, not another performance benchmark. M123 startup is not an evaluation result.
